name: Unico MVS Mini
summary: The system comes pre-loaded with 45 classic Neo Geo games, including favorites like Metal Slug, King of Fighters, and Samurai Shodown. The games are all emulated with accuracy, and the system comes with built-in save states, so you can pick up right where you left off. The graphics and sound are also faithful to the original arcade versions, making for an authentic and immersive gaming experience.
